meta.title: Session delete
meta.description: Deletes a session permanently from the sidebar: right-click a session row (or open its "..." menu) and choose "Delete session…", or use the trash button that appears on row hover. Both open a confirmation dialog, then remove the stored chat log, its projection cache, and the workspace entry, and repull the session list in place (no page reload) so the row is gone. A session that is running work is refused; stop or archive it first. A session you merely opened earlier, including the one on screen, can be deleted. The same operation is exposed to the agent as the session_delete tool. Turning the plugin off restores the stock sidebar and removes the tool.
